extName.message: Shoo for YouTube: Block Channels & Title Keywords

extDescription.message: Block YouTube channels in one click, in search and next to the player. Title keywords too. Imports old blocker lists.

cardNotSaved.message: Not saved. Reload this tab and try again.

pageHidden.message: Shoo hides this channel in search and next to the player

allHidden.message: Shoo hid all results on this page: $COUNT$

popupRevealed.message: Hidden videos are shown on this page

reloadTab.message: Reload this tab so Shoo works here

popupEmpty.message: Nothing hidden yet: hover a video and click ⊘

popupBroken.message: Looks like YouTube changed something. Channels you hid may show up again: $SURFACES$.

titleBroken.message: Shoo: YouTube may have changed something. Open for details.

welcomeTitle.message: Hide a channel once, and Shoo hides its videos in search and next to the player

welcomeImportFirst.message: If you used another blocker, export your list from it first: removing that extension deletes its list. If it's already gone, paste channel links or names into the box, one per line.

welcomeStepsBlockTube.message: BlockTube: open its settings and export. You get a file called blocktube_backup.json.

welcomeStepsChannelBlocker.message: Channel Blocker: open its settings, go to import and export, and export your list. You get a .save file.

importBox.message: Drop the file here or paste the list

importSkippedPatterns.message: Regex patterns skipped: $COUNT$ (Shoo takes plain words only)

importSkippedOther.message: Other entries skipped: $COUNT$ (single videos, comment filters, exceptions, JavaScript filters)

importIdOnly.message: Channels with an ID but no name: $COUNT$. In most places Shoo can't spot them yet. If one of their videos still shows up, hide it once and Shoo will remember the channel.

importNothing.message: No channels or words found here. Try the export file from your old blocker, or one channel per line.

importTooBig.message: This list is too long. Shoo takes up to 20,000 channels and words at once.

welcomePin.message: Pin Shoo from the puzzle icon in the toolbar. When Shoo sees that YouTube changed something and hidden channels may come back, Shoo's icon shows "!".

welcomeReloadTabs.message: Reload open YouTube tabs ($COUNT$) so Shoo works there

welcomeHowTo.message: To hide a channel, hover one of its videos and click ⊘. To add words or bring a channel back, open Shoo's menu, then "Edit list".

listWordHint.message: Checks video titles only. A word also hides longer words that start with it: "alpha" hides "alphas" too. Words of 3 letters or fewer match whole words only: "AI" hides "AI tools", not "air".

listIdOnlyRow.message: No name yet: Shoo misses this channel in most places. Hide one of its videos once and Shoo will remember it.

listMisses.message: Next to the player and in collabs, YouTube shows only a channel's name, so Shoo matches by name there. It may also hide another channel with the same name, and it can miss a renamed channel until it sees one of its videos in search. Channels added by name alone (pasted names, Channel Blocker imports, hides from next to the player) are matched by name everywhere and aren't updated after a rename. When a collab names some channels and only counts the rest, Shoo can't see the counted ones. In the row of Shorts in search, only words work.

listEmpty.message: The list is empty. Hide a channel from one of its videos on YouTube, or add a word above.
